content: Pauro akabhuga, “Emwe abhahiiri bhaane na bhataata bhaane, muniitegeerere hano nikwiisasaama embere weenyu!”
Abhaatu bhayo, hano bhakiigwa Pauro arakeerenia mukigaambo kyaabhu kye Ekieburania, ebho bhakakira kiri. Niho Pauro akageenderera kubhabhuurira,

“Enye ni Muyahudi, omwiibhurwa wo omugye gwa Tariso mukyaaro kya Kirikia. Nawe nikiniiri hano Yerusaremu, Gamarieri niwe aniegirye emigiro gyoosi gino twatigiirwe na bhazaazi bheetu. Niari no omukya bhukongʼu gwa Taatabhugya, kya guno munagwe reero yino.
Niari nirabhanyaakya abhaanabheega bhe enzira ya Yeesu, abhasubhe na abhakari, nihaabhagwaata no okubhatuura munyuumba ya abhabhohwa, na abhaandi gati waabhu niari nirabhiita.

Gano nikubhabhuurira emwe, nikyo omuseengeri omukuru hamwe na abhakaruka bhe ekiina bhoosi bharanagya kwiikirirya amangʼana gano kubha ni ge eheene. Ebho nibho bhakaaniha eziinyaarubha zyo okubhahirira Abhayahudi abharikyeetu bhano bhari mumugye gwa Damesiko. Nikabhuuka nikagya eyo, okubha nibhabhohe abhiikirirya bhe eyo, nibhareete Yerusaremu bhatinirwe ekiina.
“Hano niari niisukiri kuhika Damesiko, rihikiri eriibhaga rya kasaasabha mumwiisi, kituukiro ego obhweero bhuhaari kurwa mwiisaaro bhukabha bhuraanibharira bhukongʼu mbaara zyoosi.
Nikagwa haasi, nikiigwa eriiraka riranibhuurira, ‘Sauri, Sauri! Kwaki oraninyaakya?’
“Neenye nikabhuurya, ‘Ee Omukuru, awe ni weewi?’ “Akaanikyoora, ‘Enye neenye Yeesu wa Nazareeti, wuno okuninyaakya.’
Abharikyaane bhano twaari murugeendo hamwe bhakarora obhweero, nawe eriiraka riyo, bhataariigwiiri.
“Kweego nikabhuurya, ‘Ee Omukuru, nikoreki?’ “Akaanikyoora, ‘Imeerera! Osikire mumugye gwa Damesiko. Muyo nimwe oraabhuurirwe emirimo gino okweenderwa okore.’
Obhweero bhuhaari bhwaari bhunihukwiirye ameeso na nitaanagirye kurora. Kweego abharikyaane bhayo bhakaanigwaata okubhoko no okunikaangata tee Damesiko.

“Damesiko hayo hahaabha no omuutu wumwe, eriina ryaaye Anania. Anania wuyo yaari no omukya bhukongʼu gwo okwiigwa emigiro gyeetu, na yaari arakumibhwa na Abhayahudi bhoosi bha hayo, kubha yaari omuutu muzomu.
Kweego akaaza akiimeerera embarika waane, akaanibhuurira, ‘Omuhiiri waane Sauri, onagye kurora!’ Rugeendo rumwe ameeso gaane gakaramukya, nikamurora.
“Hayo akaanibhuurira, ‘Taatabhugya wa bhazaazi bheetu akusoriri, okubha omenye obhweendi bhwaaye, na omurore We Eheene, na omwiitegeerere eriiraka ryaaye omweene.
Goosi gano oruuzi na gano wiigwiiri, orabha oragazweenia abhaatu bhoosi, kyaabhurya orabha omumenyeekererya waaye.
Bhoono oraganyaki? Imeerera! Obatiizwe, weeriibhwe ebhibhi bhyaazo na osabhe obhutuurya ku Taatabhugya.’
“Okumara nikakyoora Yerusaremu. Hano niari niramusabha Taatabhugya mwiiseengerero, nikarora obhurori.
Mubhurori bhuyo, nikarora Omukuru aranibhuurira, ‘Okore bhwaangu orwe Yerusaremu, kwo okubha amangʼana gano okuruusya iguru waane, abhaatu bho omugye guno bhatakugiikirirya.’

“Nawe nikamukyoora, ‘Ee Omukuru, ndora abhaatu bhamenyiri bhuzomu kubha niari nirahita muziinyuumba zye eziisaango zya Abhayahudi okuratira bhano bhakukwiikirirya! Niari nirabhabhoha no okubhatema bhukongʼu.
Naabhe na amanyiinga go omumenyeekererya waazo Sitefano gakiitika, neenye nikiimeerera hayo nikiikirirya kubha yiitwe, na amakabhuuti ga bhano bhaamwiitiri, neenye nikagabhiika.’
“Hayo Omukuru akaanikyoora, ‘Ogye! Nirakutuma ogeende kubhano bhatari Abhayahudi.’ ”
Pauro ariimenyeekererya kubha woosi ni Murooma

Abhaatu bhayo bhaari bharagiitegeerera amangʼana ga Pauro bhuzomu. Nawe hano yagaambiri, “Iguru ya abhaatu bhano bhatari Abhayahudi,” rugeendo rumwe bhakataanga kwiiririirirya bharabhuga, “Omuutu wuno aruusibhweho mukyaaro! Atakweenderwa arorekane muhoru!”
Abhaatu bhayo bhakatema ekituri eno bhakutaasa emyeenda gyaabhu na bhakabha bhariirura oruteeri iguru.
Omukuru wa abhasirikare wuyo akabhabhuurira abhasirikare bhaaye, bhamusikirye Pauro munyuumba yaabhu, na bhamuteme emijariti, okubha agaambe kino kigirirye abhaatu bhayo bhateme ekituri.

Nawe abhasirikare hano bhamariri kumubhoha Pauro okubha bhamuteme, Pauro akamubhuurya omukuru wumwe wuno yaari yiimeereeri hayo, “Mbe, ni heene emigiro gye Ekirooma giriikirirya okumutema Omurooma, naabhe akyaari kutinirwa ekiina kubha asarirye?”
Omukuru wuyo hano yiigwiiri ego, akagya kumubhuurira omukuru wa abhasirikare, “Awee, oreenda kumukorabhwi? Omuutu wuno ni Murooma!”
Omukuru waabhu akahika ku Pauro, akamubhuurya, “Ombuurire, awe ni Murooma?” Pauro akamukyoora, “Hee, ni Murooma.”
Omukuru wuyo akamubhuurira, “Enye niari Omurooma kwo okuriha obhuguri bhukuru bhukongʼu.” Pauro akamukyoora, “Enye ni Murooma wo okwiibhurwa.”

Rugeendo rumwe abhasirikare bhano bhaari kweenda kumubhuurya Pauro bhakamutiga na bhakarwaho. Omukuru waabhu woosi akoobhoha bhukongʼu okwiigwa kubha Pauro ni Murooma, kwo okubha yaari aswaagirye abhohwe.
Pauro arareetwa embere we ekiina ekikuru
Hano bhwakiiri, omukuru wa abhasirikare akeenda kumenya kino kigirirye Pauro azoongerwe na Abhayahudi bhayo. Akamutazura no okubhaswaagya abhakuru bha abhaseengeri ne ekiina ekikuru
kyoosi kisikane hamwe. Okumara akamureeta Pauro, akamwiimeererya gatigati waabhu.

footnotes.text: Ekiina ekikuru. Rora amangʼana gano mu Bhugaruri bhwa Amangʼana Amakongʼu.
